title: Shopping assistant
intro: Ask where to find something this weekend, when a market opens, or which pickup slots a stall has. Every answer comes from MarketLink's own data.
botNote: Answers use the live catalogue. Intent shown under each reply.

canAnswer.title: What it can answer
canAnswer.product: Find a product across markets and stalls, with how many are left
canAnswer.stalls: Which stalls are at a market on a given day
canAnswer.slots: A stall's pickup windows and free slots
canAnswer.price: A product's price, unit and stock

how.title: How it works
how.text: Your question is matched to one of a fixed set of intents, and each intent runs a prepared query against MarketLink's own data. Answers never come from anywhere else, and the assistant cannot change anything — it only reads.
